text: The Articles of Confederation were consciously written to limit the authority of a weak central government with no chief executive, and this made the American war effort difficult because the organization was very inefficient at marshalling resources.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Historical Sketches of Centralization vs. Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782193
